tokens.name: ifm-color-primary
tokens.usage: The brand teal. The navbar's bottom rule and the active sidebar link's left rule (rule-width); the monogram's field. Not a text color in light: it reads 2.6:1 on ifm-background-color, so the active sidebar link also carries ifm-menu-color-active.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Infima's primary-dark step: button and badge hover states the theme leaves to Infima.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-darker
tokens.usage: Infima's primary-darker step. In light the same value as ifm-link-color and ifm-menu-color-active.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-darkest
tokens.usage: Infima's primary-darkest step. In light the same value as ifm-link-hover-color.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-light
tokens.usage: Infima's primary-light step. Light's value is dark's primary.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-lighter
tokens.usage: Infima's primary-lighter step. In light the same value as ifm-navbar-link-hover-color.

tokens.name: ifm-color-primary-lightest
tokens.usage: The teal tint. In light it is the active sidebar link's background (ifm-menu-color-background-active). Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: ifm-background-color
tokens.usage: The page ground behind the reading surface. ifm-font-color-base, ifm-color-content-secondary and ifm-link-color all read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: ifm-background-surface-color
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the pagination-nav links, the mobile navbar sidebar. In dark it is the light navbar's navy.

tokens.name: ifm-font-color-base
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ifm-background-color and ifm-background-surface-color. The light value is the brand navy; the dark value is the navbar's link color.

tokens.name: ifm-color-content-secondary
tokens.usage: The lead paragraph (a page's first paragraph) and other secondary copy on ifm-background-color; 5.0:1 in light, 7.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ifm-color-emphasis-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (tables, table-of-contents rule). Same values as ifm-toc-border-color.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-background-color
tokens.usage: The navbar ground and the mobile navbar-sidebar brand strip. Navy in both themes; ifm-navbar-link-color reads on it at 14.5:1.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-link-color
tokens.usage: Navbar title, links, the menu toggle, the color-mode button and the mobile sidebar's brand strip and close button, on ifm-navbar-background-color. Declared once; both themes use it.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-link-hover-color
tokens.usage: Navbar link hover and the active navbar link (Infima colors both from this variable; the active one is also underlined at underline-offset-navbar), and the navbar focus ring, on ifm-navbar-background-color (10.6:1).

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-search-input-background-color
tokens.usage: The search field on the navbar: dark's ifm-background-color, the same in both themes because the bar stays navy.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-search-input-color
tokens.usage: Typed text and the magnifier icon in the search field, on ifm-navbar-search-input-background-color (13.8:1).

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-search-input-placeholder-color
tokens.usage: The search field's placeholder and keyboard hint, on ifm-navbar-search-input-background-color (7.1:1). Dark's ifm-color-content-secondary.

tokens.name: search-local-input-active-border-color
tokens.usage: The focused search field's outline; the navbar focus color so it shows on navy.

tokens.name: ifm-menu-color
tokens.usage: Resting sidebar links on ifm-background-color.

tokens.name: ifm-menu-color-active
tokens.usage: The active sidebar link's text, on ifm-menu-color-background-active (5.5:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ifm-menu-color-background-active
tokens.usage: The active sidebar link's background. Light is the teal tint; dark is primary at 10% over ifm-background-color.

tokens.name: ifm-link-color
tokens.usage: Links in prose on ifm-background-color (5.7:1 light, 8.7:1 dark), and the page-wide focus ring (focus-ring-width, focus-ring-offset).

tokens.name: ifm-link-hover-color
tokens.usage: Link hover in prose.

tokens.name: ifm-code-background
tokens.usage: Inline code and code block ground; ifm-font-color-base reads on it.

tokens.name: ifm-toc-border-color
tokens.usage: The table-of-contents left rule. Same values as ifm-color-emphasis-200.

tokens.name: ifm-footer-background-color
tokens.usage: Infima's footer ground: the dark navbar navy, in both themes. Read directly from :root because the footer renders without Infima's footer--dark variant (footer.style is light in docusaurus.config.ts).

tokens.name: ifm-footer-color
tokens.usage: The footer line on ifm-footer-background-color (11.7:1), in both themes.

tokens.name: ifm-footer-link-color
tokens.usage: A link in the footer, should one be configured; the footer line's color.

tokens.name: ifm-footer-link-hover-color
tokens.usage: Footer link hover: the brand teal on ifm-footer-background-color (6.7:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: docusaurus-highlighted-code-line-bg
tokens.usage: A highlighted line inside a code block: primary at 12%.

tokens.name: search-local-modal-background
tokens.usage: The local-search dropdown ground. Follows ifm-background-surface-color.

tokens.name: search-local-highlight-color
tokens.usage: Matched terms in search results and on the target page, and the focused result's ground. Follows ifm-link-color in light and ifm-menu-color-active in dark.

tokens.name: search-local-hit-background
tokens.usage: A search result row. Follows ifm-background-color.

tokens.name: search-local-hit-color
tokens.usage: Search result text on search-local-hit-background. Follows ifm-font-color-base.

tokens.name: search-local-muted-color
tokens.usage: Secondary text in search results. Follows ifm-color-content-secondary.

tokens.name: search-local-hit-active-color
tokens.usage: The focused search result's text on search-local-highlight-color: white on the deep teal in light (6.2:1), navy on the light teal in dark (10.6:1).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title at its desktop size. The shell sets clamp(h1-compact, h1-fluid-size, h1), so it shrinks with the viewport and is h1-compact below breakpoint-mobile. Its letter-spacing applies to every heading level.

styles.name: h1-compact
styles.usage: The page title's floor: the smallest the clamp goes, and its fixed size below breakpoint-mobile.

styles.name: navbar-title
styles.usage: The site title beside the monogram in the navbar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Content lives in the repositories and in the canon; nothing is authored here.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: A page's first paragraph, in ifm-color-content-secondary.
styles.sample: This site renders whatever content tree it is pointed at.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Table cells; headers left-aligned; tables full width, scrolling horizontally below breakpoint-mobile.
styles.sample: DOCS_CONTENT_PATH · the staged tree · Content source

styles.name: navbar-link
styles.usage: Navbar links; the active one underlined at underline-offset-navbar.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks: ifm-code-font-size, 90% of the surrounding text, on ifm-code-background, square corners.

spacing.note: The theme inherits Infima's spacing scale and sets these few distances of its own.

tokens.name: space-menu-y
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-menu-x
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding, left and right.

tokens.name: ifm-menu-link-padding-vertical
tokens.usage: Each sidebar link's padding, top and bottom (Infima's own variable; its horizontal padding stays at Infima's default).

tokens.name: space-brand-gap
tokens.usage: Between the monogram and the site title in the navbar.

tokens.name: space-footer
tokens.usage: Footer padding on every side, at every width.

tokens.name: space-h2-above
tokens.usage: Above an h2 in prose.

tokens.name: space-content-top
tokens.usage: Above the article on desktop.

tokens.name: space-container-top
tokens.usage: Above the docs container on desktop.

tokens.name: space-article-bottom
tokens.usage: Below the article.

border.note: Edges are rules and underlines, never shadows.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: The accent rule in ifm-color-primary: under the navbar, left of the active sidebar link (the resting link carries a transparent rule of the same width so nothing shifts).

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The focus outline, in ifm-link-color on the page and ifm-navbar-link-hover-color inside the navbar.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between a focused element and its outline.

tokens.name: underline-offset-prose
tokens.usage: How far below the text a prose link's underline sits.

tokens.name: underline-offset-navbar
tokens.usage: How far below the text the active navbar link's underline sits.

radius.note: Every corner is square: the theme sets each Infima radius variable to 0.

tokens.name: ifm-global-radius
tokens.usage: Infima's global radius, zeroed. The shell also applies it explicitly to the menu, dropdowns, the search field, kbd and the back-to-top button.

tokens.name: ifm-border-radius
tokens.usage: Generic bordered boxes, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-card-border-radius
tokens.usage: Cards, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-button-border-radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-code-border-radius
tokens.usage: Inline code and code blocks, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-alert-border-radius
tokens.usage: Admonitions, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-breadcrumb-border-radius
tokens.usage: Breadcrumbs, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-pagination-nav-border-radius
tokens.usage: Previous / next links, zeroed.

tokens.name: ifm-tabs-border-radius
tokens.usage: Tabs, zeroed.

shadow.note: The theme draws with rules, not shadows; the one shadow belongs to the search dropdown.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-shadow
tokens.usage: The navbar has no shadow; its edge is the rule-width ifm-color-primary rule.

tokens.name: search-local-modal-shadow
tokens.usage: The local-search dropdown.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the site chrome.

tokens.name: ifm-navbar-height
tokens.usage: Navbar height.

tokens.name: doc-sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The docs sidebar width on desktop.

tokens.name: navbar-logo-size
tokens.usage: The monogram's width and height in the navbar; docusaurus.config.ts reads it for the logo's dimensions.

tokens.name: navbar-search-input-min-height
tokens.usage: The search field's minimum height.

tokens.name: h1-fluid-size
tokens.usage: The viewport term of the page title's clamp: clamp(h1-compact, h1-fluid-size, h1).

tokens.name: breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: At and below this width the sidebar folds into the navbar, headings take their compact sizes and tables scroll. Docusaurus's own breakpoint; the media queries in custom.css repeat the literal because CSS cannot read a custom property there.
